name: yorledger
description: YorLedger — ledger and billing for saree and silk shops (web, Android APK, desktop)

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run dev --workspace=web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=shared && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.test:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-yorledger "npx playwright test -c tests/e2e/playwright.config.ts"
